name: Ambulance Insights
focus: Rural and metropolitan ambulance care: equity, access and training

episodes.title: Beyond Borders: Improving Global Patient Outcomes
episodes.notes: How do we bridge the gap in global ambulance care? From differing service models and overlapping jurisdictions to the realities of workforce distribution and remoteness, these challenges create disparities in access - and we’re asking the big question: how do we improve outcomes for patients worldwide? This episode we’re doing things a little differently, bringing you a global panel of three…
